caveat: Breach figures come from a vendor survey of 5,000 IT and security leaders.

expert.text: Third-party involvement in breaches doubled from 15% to 30%, and leaked secrets in GitHub repositories took a median 94 days to fix.
Identity-based attacks rose 32% in the first half of 2025, 97% were password attacks, and modern MFA blocks over 99% of attempts.

line: Most attacks now start with a stolen login. Machine identities multiply fastest.
scope: Human and machine identities, sign-in and access rights. Not the permissions of AI agents.
title: Identity-first security
why: 71% of organisations had an identity-related breach in the past year.
Weak handling of machine identities played a part in 41% of incidents.
Only one in three firms regularly audits service accounts and machine identities.
